title: Gratitude that returns the heart to Naam
subtitle: For the day that needs mercy noticed again
description: These readings move gratitude from mood to remembrance, until the heart sees mercy as a summons back to Naam.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Gratitude is not self-improvement; it is the recognition that mercy has already been at work.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let one noticed mercy turn into simran rather than a passing good feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey makes gratitude a doorway back to Naam.
evidence.turn: The heart becomes steadier when thanks becomes remembrance.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the mercy, say Waheguru, and let the gift change the next action.
